text:
Sophie Lane: Heads up 1 dropping StratusCore joint solution assets for review. Need quick checks: co-brand lockups for marketplace, alt-text for accessibility, and a short legal consent for using a customer quote. Stratus shared their logos here: https://stratus.example.com/pack.zip

Diego Rivera: Quick visual note: Stratus's cyan palette fails WCAG contrast on light gray backgrounds when their primary logomark sits on left. Recommend a dark neutral backdrop or a white-outlined variant. I'll create a dark-mode and light-mode export.

Nina Park: Marketplace sizes we need: AWS hero 600x315, Azure hero 1200x627, GCP tile 300x300. Also request 1:1 and 3:2 crops for different marketplaces. Alt text should include the metric. Partner quote draft: "With Redwood and StratusCore we slashed serving outages and improved 99th percentile latency by 18%". Need partner attribution and timeframe.

LegalBot: Flag: "slashed serving outages" is non-specific. Please get a concrete definition (e.g., reduced outage count from X to Y over Z months) from StratusCore. Performance claims need dataset, timeframe, and signed approval. Also provide trademark line: "StratusCore™ is a trademark of StratusCore, Inc."

Mikkel (StratusCore): Confirming baseline: outage incidents decreased from 9/month to 2/month over the Q1 2025 integration period; 99th percentile latency measured on our 50k-sample synthetic workload. PM shared email to Legal and Nina a few minutes ago. Alt text tweak OK: "StratusCore and Redwood Inference solution brief cover showing 18% improvement in 99th percentile latency and fewer serving outages."

Diego Rivera: Uploaded exports to staging: https://redwood.assets.internal/stratuscore/pack_v3.zip contains dark/light variants, 1:1 and 3:2 crops, and outlined variants for small sizes. Also added a 32x32 favicon with simplified mark.

Sophie Lane: Great. Action items: 1) @Diego finalize dark-mode tiles and push to marketplace/images/stratuscore. 2) @Nina update case study with partner attribution once Legal confirms email. 3) @LegalBot draft short consent and trademark line. Target: EOD Monday. Any issues?

Diego Rivera: Will do, no issues.

LegalBot: Starting consent workflow and will share phrasing for review.

Mikkel (StratusCore): Email approval sent with metric breakdown and PM signature. Thanks team.

Sophie Lane: Thanks all. Please react with :white_check_mark: when complete.
